author: raymond91125
body:
Dear all, 

The proposal has been made to obsolete
GO:0097260 eoxin A4 synthase activity (no annotation)
GO:0051120 hepoxilin A3 synthase activity (to be replaced by GO:0106255 hydroperoxy icosatetraenoate isomerase activity)
GO:0050335 thiocyanate isomerase activity (no annotation)
see https://github.com/geneontology/go-ontology/issues/29695

Experimental annotations that need to be reviewed are here: 
https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1E7ggJddxYXMuJwJyz7s11U9bwVb4ah5efgvZrOQvAtg/edit?gid=0#gid=0

Impacted groups: 
RGD 1
Reactome 1
UniProt 3 (automatic transfer)

** Group contacts: https://github.com/geneontology/go-site/blob/master/metadata/group-contacts.csv
----

Mappings that need to be reviewed: (InterPro2GO, UniProt-Keywords, UniRule) 
KEGG_REACTION:R04010 > GO:thiocyanate isomerase activity ; GO:0050335
EC:5.99.1.1 > GO:thiocyanate isomerase activity ; GO:0050335
RHEA:10004 > GO:thiocyanate isomerase activity ; GO:0050335
MetaCyc:THIOCYANATE-ISOMERASE-RXN > GO:thiocyanate isomerase activity ; GO:0050335
Reactome:R-HSA-2161794 > GO:hepoxilin A3 synthase activity ; GO:0051120
Reactome:R-HSA-8942208 > GO:hepoxilin A3 synthase activity ; GO:0051120
Reactome:R-HSA-2162019 > GO:eoxin A4 synthase activity ; GO:0097260



Thanks.
title: Review annotations to direct children of isomerase activity

author: raymond91125
